lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular nodes organized into vertical columns. Each visible column posterior to the gill region contains between 3 and 4 distinct nodes, maintaining approximately equal horizontal displacement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity are visible, with the circular high-luminance blobs situated at the vertical and horizontal center points of these bands, creating a reinforced matrix pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a light-to-dark vertical pixel gradient from the superior to inferior surface that creates a defined linear shadow line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains multiple high-luminance blobs, including one prominent cluster located near the anterior edge and a sparse cluster of 3-4 nodes distributed toward the posterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semicircular notch is visible on the trailing edge (posterior margin) of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct fusiform silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned near the pectoral fin and lower ventral flank.
